  0% {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(0, -50%) scale(0.5);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeOutToTopRight {

  }

  100% {

    transform: translate(40%, -40%) scale(0.5);
  }
}

  100% {

  }

.logo-bg {

.logo-sticky {

@keyframes open {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  100% {
    transform: translateY(45px);
  }
}

@keyframes collapse {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(27px);
  }

  100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes fadeOut {
  0% {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes fadeInFromTopRight {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(0, -50%) scale(0.5);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeOutToTopRight {
  0% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
  }

  80% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(30%, -30%) scale(0.6);
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(40%, -40%) scale(0.5);
  }
}

@keyframes scaleOut {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }

  100% {
    transform: scale(0);
  }
}

.logo-animation {
  width: 100%;
  background-color: #202d3c;
  z-index: 999;
}

  animation: open 0.5s ease-in-out forwards;
}

.push-up {
  animation: collapse 0.5s ease-in-out;
}
